Dialogs.Dialog: Well then, shall we get started？
I think I only want to hear happy stories today. Deal？
I'll apologize in advance... I might complain a bit today.
It's our first time meeting, isn't it？
It's our first time, but let's get along well, okay？
I'm Nene Anegasaki. Nice to meet you♪
Oho, you've got that 'something good happened' look on your face.
How are things on your end？
Huh？ You look a bit down.
Nice to meet you. I feel like we're going to get along great, don't you？
The pleasure's mine! Let's have a good time.
Yep♪ I'll tell you all about it later, okay？
Hehe... I'm grinning ear to ear, aren't I？
That's right!▼ I'll tell you all about it later, so get ready♪
I've been doing pretty well, I think？
Sorry. I shouldn't be making a face like this, right？
Just a bit... Don't worry about me.
Ahaha... I'm really not at my best today.
Mmm... Could you give me some advice, please？
That hits a little close to home.
Hey, can we have a quick advice session？
Actually, there's something I want to ask.
Whatever's on your mind, I'm happy to help.
I totally get it. I'm the same way.
Now, now. It'll all work out eventually.
Don't give up. Let's take our time with it, okay？
I think there's another way to look at it, though.
Hmm... I don't know if I can agree with that.
That might be true, but... hmm.
Saying that so suddenly... You're putting me on the spot!
Sorry, you've got me stumped. Can I pass？
That's... let's just keep that a secret.
Ehh？ No way, I can't answer that.
Understood. You'll have to tell me next time, okay？
Sorry, that's kind of hard to talk about, isn't it？
Hehe, your face is all red, you know？
Aw, that's no fair, saying things like that.
So, there's something I wanted to talk about...
...All right, all right. My lips are sealed.
Oh, you're so shy. I wouldn't mind talking about it, you know.
Wait, I didn't say anything, did I？
Jeez, what is it？ Do you want some attention？
And now, time for an interview! Today's topic: how things are going with your boyfriend lately.
Just thinking about him fills my heart...▼I never imagined I could love someone this much before we started dating...
Hehe, lately I'm completely under his spell.▼What's gotten into me？
We're totally head over heels in love!▼Even I can tell how crazy I am about him. But I just can't stop...▼
Sorry, I'm thinking about him even right now.▼Being in love is almost scary... I'm just completely crazy about him.▼
He's got me totally wrapped around his finger. To think he could change me this much... It's almost unfair how much I love him.▼
My head is totally filled with him, like I'm walking on clouds.▼Am I letting him rub off on me a little too much？
The thing is, we're actually in a fight right now. I know it's no good, but I can't seem to find a way to just be honest with him...
Truth is, we're fighting right now. But I know I'm at fault for being stubborn, too... *sigh* I really wish he'd reach out to me.
We had a fight the other day, and it's been awkward ever since... I need to make up with him soon.
Rushing things won't do any good. Let's take your mind off it with some girl talk today, okay？
Don't worry, you two will definitely make up. I'm sure he knows how you feel.
How are things when you're with him？ Touchy-feely stuff, I mean.
When you're alone together, you get... affectionate, right？ How is it？
Just between us, how's his kissing？ Is he good at it？
He's super good at it. I just love his kisses▼
He gives such amazing kisses. This older girl doesn't stand a chance▼
It leaves a bit to be desired... I kind of lose the mood halfway through.
I wouldn't say he's good. I know he's trying his best, so I don't say anything, but...
I feel like there's not enough affection, but do I need to be the one to take the lead？
He doesn't really kiss me much... Could that be a warning sign？
Are you having fun on dates with him？ How've things been lately？
Mostly dates after school, I'd say？ Even weekdays are lots of fun▼
Pretty relaxed, I guess... Nothing special, but it's always fun.
We had such a wonderful date the other day▼ A memory I'll treasure forever▼
I went to his place the other day！ Hehe, it was so much fun.
I invited him over to my place on our last date▼
Something made my heart race like crazy. Hehe, just thinking about it makes me grin.
Still, wouldn't you like to take your time and enjoy a full-day date once in a while？
Aren't you interested in hanging out in your boyfriend's room？
After-school dates are nice, but wouldn't going out on a day off be fun, too？
Don't you want to go on an extra-special date to remember, just the two of you？
Wouldn't you like more casual dates after school, too？
Haven't you ever wanted to stop by his room after a date？
It's sweet when he goes all out planning dates♪ But that can be tiring every time, so ordinary dates are nice too, right？
Aww, that's great！ I'm so jealous～！
I love having him take me to all kinds of places. How about you？
So, will you invite him over to your room next time？
Keep that up and invite yourself right into his room next time！
Hehe, nice. Don't you feel like the two of you got a whole lot closer？
What would you do if, on a date, he told you he wanted the two of you to stay together all night？
Oh, I might actually be thinking that...
Hmm, I wonder？ I hadn't really thought about it like that, but...
I won't know until the time comes, but... in my heart, I'm totally okay with it.
If the mood is romantic enough, I might just take the plunge and say yes▼
That's a bit much, honestly... I wouldn't know what to do.
Hey, hey, do you cook for your boyfriend very often？
Hey, wanna talk about cooking？ For your boyfriend, of course.
I guess I usually head over to his place and make him breakfast.
Let's see... I guess I often have dinner together with him over at his place.
I like baking snacks for tea time. Especially when we study together♪
When it's a special date, I really go all out with my cooking. It makes it more memorable, right？ Hehe▼
I mostly make Japanese food. It really feels like proper home cooking, don't you think？
I usually make Western food. I just thought it might make him happy.
Come to think of it, I make Chinese food pretty often. Hearty portions are nice, right？
It's so fun just thinking about what to make for him, you know？
I love regional food, so I make all kinds of dishes. It feels like you're traveling right there, in a way.
Then I'll teach you my best dish, so give it a shot. It's really yummy♪
What I made the other day was a huge hit with him! I'll give you the recipe, so you should try it out.
That helps so much! I've been wanting to learn a new dish.
Thank you! Next time, I'll share one of my recipes too.
Hey, how do you think I can get better at dishes I'm not good at making？
I want to match his tastes as much as I can... What should I do？
It's a little embarrassing, but... my repertoire is so small, it's a real problem.
Food can change completely with just one seasoning. Maybe look for a new one？
I see... Then how about trying all kinds of recipes？ You might get the hang of it before you know it.
In that case, practice makes perfect. If you keep trying again and again, you're bound to get better.
Maybe start by matching the seasonings to his tastes？ Just doing that makes a big difference, honestly.
If it were me, I'd just ask him what he likes straight up. Some things you'll never know unless you ask, right？
Is that so？ In that case, I can teach you my best dish.
Oh, is that all？ If that's what's on your mind, I'll share some great recipes!
You want good food on a date, right？ Are you happy with the meals on your dates？
Hey, what are your meals like when you go on dates？
...Hmm, we don't really go out to eat that much.
We eat a ton on our dates♪ Though on the flip side, I'm getting worried about my weight...
Meal times can be a little depressing... His tastes seem pretty different from mine.
He and I have the exact same taste in food. I always look forward to meal times♪
Chatting with him while we eat is so much fun.
We're always flirting, even while we eat... Jeez▼
There's a place we go a lot. We usually eat there whenever we're on a date.
We try all kinds of places. It's fun figuring out where to go, isn't it？
I think we've tried every spot around here! Leave the Towano foodie intel to us♪
Different food tastes might actually be a serious issue... Should I have a proper talk with him about it？
You want to hold onto date memories, right？ Do you two take photos together？
Taking photos to commemorate a date—that happens, right？
Hey, what would you do if he said he wanted to take... naughty photos, too？
When he takes your picture, ever thought of giving him a little fan service？
My boyfriend doesn't really take that many photos.
He loves taking pictures. It's so fun watching our album of memories grow♪
All his photos are a bit... I wish he'd make me look a little nicer, though.
My boyfriend's great at photos. He's got a wonderful eye for it.
I'm glad he takes pictures, but his angles are a bit... lewd？ Boys will be boys, huh.
His camera is incredible. He's always collecting all sorts of parts for it.
His photo won an award recently! Though it was of me, so... I'm happy, but embarrassed, too. Hehe.
Why not？ Sounds fine to me. Just let him shoot whatever he wants▼
If he wants to that badly... maybe just a little...
I don't think that's right, so I'd probably scold him and say no.
Hmm... If I don't like it, I just tell him honestly.
He only takes weird photos, it's so annoying. Should I give him a good scolding？
I've been noticing for a bit, but that's a really cute necklace you're wearing.
What a lovely ring. Could that be...？
What a lovely ring. Could that be...？
That hairstyle looks great on you.
That outfit is so cute! It looks perfect on you.
Ah, you noticed？ My boyfriend gave it to me.
I picked this color because he complimented it. It's fun changing up my look.
I like to aim for fashion that's fun for me, but also makes him happy, you know？
Let's get even cuter and make our boyfriends head over heels for us♪
To be honest... I still don't really know about that sort of thing...
Well... I hope days like this can just keep on going... Then little by little, we might start to change...
The future, huh... There's so much I want to do with him, I can't put it into words. Hehe♪
Of course I think about it. Like putting his last name with my first name... ▼Am I getting ahead of myself？
Of course I'll stay with him forever. Even if I tried to leave, he wouldn't let me go▼
I've decided I'm spending my life with him▼ Even when we're old and gray, forever and ever... you know？
I think us meeting was fate from God. I want to spend every day like this forever...▼
Is it already this late？ We got totally carried away talking, didn't we.
Thanks for today. I feel a little cheered up, thanks to you.
Hehe, it's been a while since I chatted this much.
I hate to say goodbye, but that's all for today.
Say hi to your boyfriend for me, okay？
It's night already. Get home safe, okay？
It's about bedtime, right？ Well, good night.
It was so nice talking today. See you around.
I should get home soon. If I'm out too late, he'll start worrying about me.
